notes.title: Subscription Option is Available
notes.notes: TwoSeventy is very proud to announce a subscription model costing $6.50.  If a player picks the subscription option that player will get full access to all available candidates in TwoSeventy plus any new candidates via New Candidate Mondays.  This option is available in the TwoSeventy shop.  If bought the player  has 30 days to try it out and play unlimited matchups.  During the 30 days if that player doesn't like the subscription that player can opt out.  If opt out before 30 days that player still has access to unlimited players.
